morgan: Hey team — need help adding my partner to benefits. We registered a civil union in CA mid-February but partner's home country doesn't issue marriage certificates. Partner moved here on a dependent visa on 2024-02-20 and their SSN is pending. Can we get coverage retro to 2024-02-20 to cover an ER/dental visit on 2024-03-02? What docs do you need and what's the process?

jamie (People Ops): Hey Morgan — quick q: when was the civil union officially recorded in CA? and do you have proof of cohabitation (lease, joint bank)? Also FYI if SSN is pending we can still enroll but payroll needs alternate ID for first run.

morgan: The CA registration completed 2024-02-15. I have a scanned civil_union_record.pdf from the county, a joint lease starting 2023-09, and joint bank stmt (last 3 months). Partner also has the dependent visa I-94 and passport.

ana (Benefits Admin): Hi Morgan — thanks, sounds doable. For domestic/civil-union partner enrollment we typically accept the following (pick 2 where applicable):
1) State civil union or domestic partnership registry document
2) Joint lease or mortgage showing both names (last 12 months)
3) Joint bank/credit card statements (last 3 months)
4) Utility bill with both names or evidence of shared address
5) Copy of partner's visa/immigration docs showing dependent status

We can also accept an affidavit of domestic partnership if county docs are ambiguous. Because the civil union is already recorded in CA (you said 2024-02-15) the effective date we can consider is the date of the county recording, provided docs are uploaded within the QLE window. For retro coverage to 2024-02-20 we need submission within 30 days of the QLE — looks like you're within that window.

Required next steps: please upload all proofs to Workday > Benefits > Add Dependent and use subject line exactly:
```
ADD PARTNER: Morgan Lastname / Partner Lastname - CA civil union - effective 2024-02-20
```
Include files named: `civil_union_record.pdf`, `lease_joint.pdf`, `bank_stmt_3mo.pdf`, `i94_visa.pdf`.

payroll (Payroll): Heads up on proration and premium recoup: if we make the effective date 2024-02-20 and payroll for Feb already posted, you'll likely see retroactive premium deductions applied across the next 1-2 payroll runs (we aim to avoid a big single deduction). Example calc: monthly premium $200, effective 02/20 -> employer/employee split prorated for 11 days in Feb = (200/28)*11 = $78.57 (employee share depending on plan). If payroll cutoff is before docs are processed we wait until next cycle which may delay card/ID issuance. Please also attach the SSN application receipt if available so we can flag the record.

jamie (People Ops): Also note dental claims: if ER/dental claim already paid, we can submit an appeal to the dental carrier with the retro coverage effective date, but approval isn't guaranteed. Add the ER/dental claim receipt to the upload and mark as "urgent - retrospective claim".

hrbot (People Ops Bot): Case created: PO-2024-3589. Please include case ID in your Workday upload subject. Link to checklist: https://internal.redwood/procedures/partner-enroll-checklist (internal).

ana (Benefits Admin): Quick checklist copy (paste into upload):
```
- civil_union_record.pdf
- lease_joint.pdf (or 2 proofs of shared residence)
- bank_stmt_3mo.pdf
- i94_visa.pdf or passport page
- ER_dental_receipt.pdf (if requesting retrospective claim)
- SSN_receipt_or_pending.pdf (optional)
Case ID: PO-2024-3589
```

morgan: Thanks all — uploading now. One follow up: our civil union certificate uses different name ordering (Portuguese style) — will that cause issues?

ana (Benefits Admin): Usually ok as long as the document shows both names and there's matching ID (passport). If name formats differ, include a short signed affidavit from you explaining the ordering — that's acceptable. If Legal needs to sign off for foreign-name format we'll advise.

jamie (People Ops): I'll watch the case. If benefits or carrier push back we'll escalate to Legal for a determination on foreign civil-union documents. Please CC me on the Workday submission. :white_check_mark:

morgan: Uploaded everything to Workday and added Case ID. Thanks!

ana (Benefits Admin): Got it — I'll validate docs today and update the case. If everything looks good we'll set effective date to 2024-02-20 and submit retro premium recoup instructions to Payroll. Expect email confirmation within 48 hours.

payroll (Payroll): Noted — once Benefits confirms we'll calculate prorations and email payroll deduction schedule. If SSN arrives later we'll update records to replace alternate ID.

morgan: Appreciate the quick help :clap:
